title: Audible and visual driving alerts
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on audible or visual warnings while driving, with one favorable comment about wildlife alerts and several unclear problem reports including missing alerts and an inability to drive home due to a dead battery.

positive.summary: The positive review values the vehicle's flashing and audible warning for detecting a deer in the roadway during a nighttime drive.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined reviews mention missing audible or visual alerts and a dead battery that prevented driving home, but the sample is too limited to clarify the exact issues or contexts.

limitations: The topic mixes at least two distinct subjects: alert behavior while driving and a dead 48-volt battery preventing the car from being driven home.
Most examples are undetermined, so the underlying problem details and user sentiment are not fully clear.
The sample is very small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all G70 vehicles or owners.
